intro.text: A large landmass on the Eelakin's world.

description.text: It lies somewhere south of the homeisles, within sailing distance, and is described as a frozen waste. Its animals differ from those of the islands; ravens, for one, are mainland birds.

Eelakin tales speak of vast cities and wars, and because the Eelakin probably did not begin on the homeisles, some set those tales on the mainland, the nearest large landmass. Yet explorers who have seen parts of it found no ruins or other traces, and scientists such as Ruen believe no one has ever lived there, so the Eelakin must have come from elsewhere.
